content.label: Academy & Workshops
content.title:
Train with the
Best in Rajasthan
content.text: The Actors Academy of Rajasthan is ATR's educational wing — a dedicated space for serious theatre artists. Our faculty includes seasoned directors, National School of Drama alumni, and cultural practitioners with decades of experience.

courses.title: Foundation in Theatre Arts
courses.desc: Voice modulation, body movement, stage presence, and script reading — the essential toolkit for every actor.

courses.title: Direction & Dramaturgy
courses.desc: Learn the craft of stage direction, play analysis, blocking, and visual storytelling from experienced directors.

courses.title: Applied Theatre for Social Change
courses.desc: Use theatre as a tool for community engagement, awareness campaigns, and advocacy in social contexts.

courses.title: Rajasthani Folk Traditions
courses.desc: Study traditional Khyal, Turra-Kalagi and other folk performance forms unique to Rajasthan.

audience.title: Reaching Every Corner of Rajasthan
audience.text: From packed proscenium theatres in Jaipur to village squares in rural districts, ATR takes theatre to where it matters most. Our outreach programmes have brought live performances to audiences who have never experienced professional theatre.
